source.title: eCommerce behavior data from multi category store
source.publisher: REES46 (Kaggle owner mkechinov), collected by the Open CDP project
source.obtained_with: Kaggle API through the kaggle Python package (kaggle==2.2.4), October 2019 file only (python -m funnel.ingest)
source.publisher_usage_statement: You can use this dataset for free. Just mention the source of it: link to this page and link to [REES46 Marketing Platform](https://rees46.com).

contents.grain: One row is one logged event.

pre_analysis_findings.finding: Products with more than one distinct price
Category codes mapping to more than one category_id
Sessions with more than one user_id
Purchase events with no cart event of the product in the session
Cart events with no view at or before them in the session
Sessions with more than one purchase event
(session, product) pairs with repeated purchase events

decisions.title: Deduplication
decisions.summary: Exact duplicate rows are removed; rows that differ in any column are kept.

decisions.title: Zero prices
decisions.summary: Zero-price events count as events but are excluded from every value.

decisions.title: Price
decisions.summary: Revenue uses the purchase price; carted value uses each pair's latest non-zero cart price.

decisions.title: Order and revenue
decisions.summary: One order is one valid session with an observed purchase.

decisions.title: Purchase paths
decisions.summary: Purchases are split by whether the product has a cart event in the same session.
changes: 2026-09-26 · Clarifications before the first mart build (Sections 6, 9, 10)

decisions.title: Cart event order
decisions.summary: Cart events count whether or not a view preceded them.

decisions.title: Breakdowns
decisions.summary: Missing category and brand form an explicit unknown level, with its share stated.
changes: 2026-09-26 · Clarifications before the first mart build (Sections 6, 9, 10)
2026-09-26 · Category cart-to-purchase rate and category revenue population (Section 9)

decisions.title: Session rules
decisions.summary: Sessions as logged; null-session events and multi-user sessions are excluded.
changes: 2026-09-26 · Clarifications before the first mart build (Sections 6, 9, 10)

decisions.title: Event types
decisions.summary: Only view, cart, and purchase exist, and all three are used.

decisions.title: Time
decisions.summary: Timestamps are UTC as logged; the store's local time zone is unknown.

limitations.text: There is no order or transaction ID, so an order is defined as a session with an observed purchase.
Repeated purchase events of one product in a session may be extra units or repeated logging; both revenue figures are shown where the difference matters.
A session is the logged user_session. Purchases in other sessions or on other devices are not linked, so no observed purchase in a session does not mean no purchase.
Most purchase events have no cart event for that product in the same session.
Category and brand are missing on part of the log and form an explicit unknown level.
Times are UTC. The store's local time zone is unknown, so no hour-of-day result describes local behavior.
The log covers one month, so results say nothing about seasonality or longer-term trends.
Observed means logged: an event absent from this log is not evidence that it did not happen.
